=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4481 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `gh api .../actions/jobs/${JOB_ID}/logs` call omits `--allow-escape-sequences`, and `2>/dev/null || true` hides the refusal, so `JOB_LOG` is always empty.
  WHY: The `evidence=run_log` branch is dead code, so the step still ends with the generic "Could not locate tracking issue" error.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4482 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unanchored substring match on `AI_ENGINE_CAPACITY_WAIT role=ORCHESTRATE outcome=deferred` also matches the `run:` source text echoed in the job log (orchestrate.yml:902).
  WHY: Once the log read works, runs that failed for other reasons are misreported as `claude_capacity` with `evidence=run_log`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4491 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The capacity-tracker fallback queries `repos/${TEST_REPO}/issues` for `ai:provider-outage`, but orchestrate_poll.yml:288 files the tracker in `github.repository`.
  WHY: When TEST_REPO differs from github.repository the fallback finds no tracker, so the generic error fires. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; anthropic gave a hardening suggestion only, and z-ai cleared it as correct.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4471-4504 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: One jobs call followed by up to ~100 per-job log `gh api` calls forms a per-item REST loop (§14).
  WHY: It risks rate limits or timeouts on an already failing path. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR; the other reviewers rated it NIT as cost hygiene on a bounded path.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:998-1002, 1227-1231, 1602-1606, 5051-5055 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The capacity check sits after the success-label checks in the clarify, plan and implement loops but before them in the alt-model loop.
  WHY: The ordering is inconsistent across loops, though anthropic found it intentional and correct, so it is informational only.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4481 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `2>/dev/null || true` on the log fetch makes a failed download indistinguishable from a log without the marker.
  WHY: No `::warning::` or stderr is recorded, unlike the sibling tracking-issue poll, which defeats the change's diagnosability goal.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Optional but recommended: add one preflight step in the E2E jobs (or `resolve-version`). If a trusted, open `ai:provider-outage` tracker with the `kind=capacity` marker exists, stop the gate at once with a `claude_capacity` notice" (issue #8217, Suggested fix §4)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, `resolve-version` or the top of the e2e-smoke-test / e2e-alt-model-test / orchestrate-decompose-test jobs
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No preflight step was added to any E2E job or `resolve-version`, only in-loop checks, and changelog.d/8217-release-gate-capacity-wait.md does not mention one. Severity ranges from NIT (the item is optional) to MAJOR (gemini).
- requirement: "Regression coverage: extend the existing contract tests ... asserting that each wait loop matches `ai:claude-capacity-wait` and writes `status=claude_capacity`." (issue #8217, Suggested fix §5)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The clarify, plan, implement and orchestrate-fallback bodies are covered only by string-order and `bash -n` checks, and only the alt-model loop runs against a stubbed `gh`. Severity ranges from NIT to MAJOR (gemini). z-ai judged the requirement met.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  PROBLEM: The unanchored substring also matches the echoed `run:` script at orchestrate.yml:902.
  WHY: Once the log read works, every orchestrate run log matches and real causes are hidden.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:998-1002, 1227-1231, 1602-1606, 5051-5055 | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The capacity check sits after the success checks in the clarify and plan loops, and before them in the alt-model loop.
  WHY: It does not fail. The ordering is intentional and consistent with the issue (informational only).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4479-4486 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A per-item REST loop loads each full job log into a shell variable (§14).
  WHY: It is bounded to about 101 calls on an already failing path, so this is cost hygiene only.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Regression coverage: ... a case asserting that each wait loop matches `ai:claude-capacity-wait` and writes `status=claude_capacity`."
  Expected change site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py
  Evidence of absence: The clarify, plan and implement loops get only string-order and `bash -n` checks, and only the alt-model loop runs against a `gh` stub. A stubbed run of the orchestrate fallback would have caught findings 1 and 2. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Optional but recommended: add one preflight step in the E2E jobs (or `resolve-version`) ... stop the gate at once with a `claude_capacity` notice."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, `resolve-version` or the head of the e2e jobs
  Evidence of absence: No preflight step was added. The issue marks it optional, so this is not a required gap. | severity=NIT | confidence=2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): fix line 4481 with `--allow-escape-sequences` and anchor the 4482 match with `Z AI_ENGINE_CAPACITY_WAIT role=ORCHESTRATE outcome=deferred`; at lines 4491-4492 the tracker query uses `${TEST_REPO}` while orchestrate_poll.yml:288 uses `github.repository`, so add a comment or query `${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

  PROBLEM: One jobs call plus up to 100 per-job log calls in the orchestrate-decompose step.
  WHY: This is a high-cost per-item REST pattern (§14) that may hit rate limits or time out the step.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Optional but recommended: add one preflight step in the E2E jobs (or `resolve-version`). If a trusted, open `ai:provider-outage` tracker with the `kind=capacity` marker exists, stop the gate at once with a `claude_capacity` notice rather than starting the live phases." (issue #8217, Suggested fix §4)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, e.g., in `resolve-version` or early in the E2E jobs.
  Evidence of absence: No such preflight check was added; the gate starts the live E2E phases before checking for capacity in the loop. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Regression coverage: extend the existing contract tests ... asserting that each wait loop matches `ai:claude-capacity-wait` and writes `status=claude_capacity`." (issue #8217, Suggested fix §5)
  Expected change site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py
  Evidence of absence: The tests use string-order and bash-syntax checks, and only the alt-model wait loop is exercised end-to-end for exit code and `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` status. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
